question_en:
The Science Museum needs to select teaching cards on "circular channels" from the RCSB PDB-101 "Molecule of the Month" main images for 2024 and 2025. Please answer:

After examining each monthly main image one by one, which images contain a molecular surface forming a continuous ring that is closed on all sides, where this surface completely surrounds an opening through which the white page background is directly visible? Please provide a complete table of "Year-Month — Topic — Judgment". Which topics meet the above conditions, and how many are there in total?

Gaps between different components, arches open at the top or bottom, and small black shadows inside the molecule do not count as openings that meet the conditions.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of "Year-Month — Topic — Judgment", followed by a Q&A section listing all qualifying topics and their total count.

# Detailed Simulated Retrieval Trajectory · 1-2-D01

## Step 01 · parse_task / Define set, image unit, and delivery fields

Action: Read the question, separate "complete scope," "visual conditions," "itemized table," and "summary"; first establish the full member list, then perform filtering.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): Within the RCSB PDB-101 date-based archives, there are 24 monthly main images covering the two complete years 2024 and 2025; do not substitute all illustrations within a topic for the designated main image.

Unified judgment rule: There must be a continuous molecular surface forming a ring closed on all sides, completely surrounding an opening through which the white page background is directly visible. Gaps between components, arches open at the top or bottom, black shadows, and ring interiors filled with light-colored molecules do not count.

Result of this step: Determine the current predicate; each formal member retains only one row; cannot merely retrieve or report positive examples.
